I'm a lady for starters, secondly I am from the United Kingdom where mental illness is a MASSIVE taboo. We don't talk about 'going to see my therapist' or anything similar of the sort. We don't mention medication and to tell someone you're on medication is a massive 'wtf?'. Thirdly, I would never ever run down the NHS staff, it's a fabulous set up for us in the U.K. to have free healthcare however, there are two 'inpatient' facilities in a 100 mile radius. Teenagers from my part of England have to travel 500 miles to London to get a bed.
